as_told.title: Soviet crash retrievals revealed in opened KGB files

plain: In the 1990s, after the Soviet Union fell, the journalist George Knapp is said to have gone to Russia and come back with files on Soviet UFO activity. Michels mentions it himself, briefly, saying Knapp "brought back all these files about like their activities when it comes to UFOs." The physicist Eric Davis tells it in more detail, without naming a source. He says the KGB opened its files when the Soviet Union collapsed, that Knapp and others went there, and that they found what he calls the Thread Three documents. According to Davis, the files show Russia had its own crash retrievals, meaning recoveries of crashed craft. If true, it would mean the US was not the only nation that has recovered such craft.
